items.item_text: Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent: Social Sciences, Scientific, Computational Science, or Related Field
There is no minimum of years of experience related to healthcare, laboratory, and/or clinical research required for this position.

1-3 years of experience in (1) an experimental lab environment, clinical research, and/or conducting research in health science, (2) emotion, social behaviors, health, psychophysiology, neuroscience, and clinical aging, (3) in-home wearable/mountable technology research, and (4) computer programming and/or data management.

This position in the Clinical Health, Emotion, and Neuroscience (CHEN) Lab will provide opportunities to be involved in all aspects of the research project(s) to examine dyadic social and emotional processes between clinical populations and their family members (e.g., spousal caregivers) with an emphasis in in-home wearable/mountable technology while also using psychophysiology, behavioral coding, and participant recruitment, research visit facilitation, data collection and analysis, undergraduate research assistant management, maintaining inventory of lab supplies and equipment, manuscript preparation, documentation creation and maintenance, coordinating lab meetings, tracking lab expenses, other day-to-day administrative tasks of running a lab, and, if applicable, preparing for graduate training in either basic science, clinical/health science, or both.

Familiarity with the laboratory's computer programs (e.g., SPSS, REDCap, Qualtrics, Microsoft Office) for data entry, data sharing, questionnaire creation, and study packet design and familiarity with writing computer codes for designing tasks, data management, and/or data analyses.
Professionalism and courtesy are required in all interactions with lab members, department staff, and supervisors.
Familiarity preparing and submitting documents, such as Institutional Review Board protocols.
Ability to work with a multidisciplinary team of researchers is required.
Ability to install, operate, and troubleshoot lab equipment. Organize training and inter-departmental meetings to facilitate approval and installation of equipment/devices for data collection.
